maddeler.e:
نحونصل (form IIIq)
# نَحْوَنْصِلُ (naḥwanṣilu) /naħ.wan.sˤi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# نَحْوَنْصِلَ (naḥwanṣila) /naħ.wan.sˤi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# نَحْوَنْصِلْ (naḥwanṣil) /naħ.wan.sˤil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
